evidence.quote: thanks for the report. The DBZ-9238 [1] has been raised and a PR [2] opened.

notes: Multi-issue thread. The settled incident is the Oracle DDL parser failing on ALTER TABLE ... SPLIT PARTITION ... ONLINE (grammar bug, DBZ-9238). The title issue (NUMBER key as STRUCT) was user config: decimal.handling.mode set on sink side and StringConverter key.
